The name is often given to girls in the Muslim community to signify the love and kindness of Allah towards His creation. The name Rehmath carries the meaning “Mercy, Compassion” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu. Parents who choose Rehmath usually hope their child will grow to embody mercy, compassion and live with faith, good character and purpose.
